b16950887.desc:
This 2-bedroom residential apartment in ARY Marina View in Dubai Marina is available for rent. The layout offers a spacious open-plan living area with multiple floor-to-ceiling windows, creating a bright interior with marina and city views. Both bedrooms feature built-in wardrobes and large windows, and the unit is presented unfurnished for straightforward customization. 
Key Features:
• 2 Bedrooms
• 3 Bathrooms
• Balcony
• Full marina view
• Downtown city view
• Multiple living areas
• Built-in wardrobes
• Tile flooring
• Swimming pool access
• CCTV security
The apartment includes a long galley-style kitchen with dark wood cabinetry, black countertops, and a built-in gas hob and oven, plus a double sink and extractor hood. Several bathrooms feature beige tiling, bathtubs with glass screens, wall-mounted toilets, bidets, and large mirrors, providing functional, clean spaces. There is also a small utility area with plumbing provision suitable for laundry use. 
Living spaces are designed with light neutral finishes, decorative tile borders, and ceiling-mounted lighting, creating a practical environment. Floor-to-ceiling glazing in the living room and bedrooms offers views over the marina, canal, and surrounding towers. Multiple corridors and a defined reception area support clear circulation and convenient access to each room within the apartment. 
Residents of ARY Marina View benefit from on-site amenities such as a gym, swimming pool, spa facilities, squash courts, and a kids’ play area. The building offers reserved parking, three high-speed elevators, and 24-hour front desk and concierge services in a spacious lobby. Security systems with CCTV coverage and pre-wired high-speed internet and satellite TV enhance daily convenience. 
Dubai Marina is a well-known waterfront community with pedestrian-friendly access to Marina Walk, lined with cafes and restaurants. Grocery stores, medical facilities, hotels, and retail centres are located nearby, with beaches such as JBR Beach within easy reach for water activities. The area also offers access to the Dubai Marina Yacht Club and various leisure options, supporting a practical and active urban lifestyle.
